about: Patterns only, reviewed by hand: lines GuestTest2's log sweep drops, as re.search over a normalized line (guest_judge.normalize: numbers are N, hex HEX, times TIME). all: every guest; the others by the spec's checks.pm. A pattern marked list: also drops the indented lines under the line it matches (package names, wrapped). A new pattern re-runs only those guests. Keep it package-manager chatter: a real error must never match. The accepted per-guest lines are never here: they live on the Mac (guest-baselines), since they can hold machine IDs and hostnames.
